Body.Content:
This is for Project Operations Core and Integrated to ERP.

Enable project managers to compare multiple budget versions and select the most suitable budget before submission and approval. This capability improves decision-making by allowing users to evaluate different planning scenarios, understand financial impacts, and confidently choose the preferred budget version.

GA date: August CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
